title: POÄNG low-back armchair
description: POÄNG low-back armchair, red/Vissle black Japanese designer Noboru Nakamura is the man behind the successful POÄNG armchair, launched in 1977. In 2022 he removed the headrest – a new design as it now owns its place in the Nytillverkad collection.
materialAndCare: Supporting fabric: 100 % polypropylene; Frame: Layer-glued wood veneer, Birch veneer, Stain, Clear acrylic lacquer; Fabric: 100% polyester (min. 90% recycled); Wadding: 100% polyester (min. 80% recycled); Comfort filling: Polyurethane foam 2.0 lb/cu.ft.; Lining, underside: 100 % polypropylene
